Full release notes: **https://danbyte.net/news/v0-16-0**

### New in 0.16.1

#### Changed

- **Add several at once to the Status history widget.** The address and device pickers tick instead of picking: choose as many as you like in the list (select-all over what the search shows) or in the advanced search, and one button adds them - the picker no longer closes after each one. Any picker can offer the same with `onPickMany`.
- **Hardware that adds up.** A part records the **slot** it sits in (Socket 1, DIMM A1, Bay 3) and a CPU its **cores**; the clock list runs from 1.8 to 5.0 GHz; **Add another** on the Add part dialog saves and moves to the next name in the sequence. The Hardware tab shows what the parts total - cores and sockets, memory, storage - and the Spec sheet button offers a second, **hardware sheet** that leads with those three figures and lists the parts per kind with their slots, instead of rack position and power, and an **All in one** sheet that carries both. A sheet is named after the device and its serial number.
- **Working hours and Available as contact columns.** The Contacts list has both as optional columns from the Columns menu, so who is reachable right now reads off the overview. (#167)

#### Fixed

- The demo seeder (`seed_demo`) works again with tenant-scoped tags and site-scoped VLANs.
